values.description: Nginx terminates TLS on :443 and proxies /api/** to api-gateway. Requires docker-compose-production.yml to be running - see README/notes for setup. Self-signed cert: in Postman, disable Settings > General > SSL certificate verification, or Insomnia > Preferences > General > Validate SSL Certificates, for this to work.
notification-service is NOT defined in docker-compose-production.yml at all - run it separately (plain HTTP, no TLS wired to it individually)
product-service is NOT defined in docker-compose-production.yml either - run it separately (plain HTTP, no TLS wired to it individually)
Set this from the Login response's "token" field
